_readme: Caption pool for DuelDirector. Tokens: {ap}/{vp} attacker/victim piece, {ah}/{vh} haus display names, {aa}/{va} haus sigil animals, {am}/{vm} haus mottos, {wh} winning haus (checkmate only), {p}/{h}/{a}/{m} piece/haus/animal/motto (promotion only). Entries may pin 'attacker' or 'victim' to a piece name (pawn/rook/knight/bishop/queen/king). All lines are original — archetype homage only, no borrowed dialogue or names.

kill_lines.text: The {aa} of {ah} remembers, ser {vp}.
{ah} sends its regards, {vp}.
Every debt is paid in full. Ask the {vp}.
Winter marches south, and the {va} marches nowhere.
A {ap} of {ah} settles every account.
Sing no songs for the {vp} of {vh}.
The {va} kneels. The {aa} does not notice.
Steel keeps the only oath that matters, {vp}.
One less banner over {vh} tonight.
The board bends the knee to {ah}.
'{vm},' they said. The {aa} disagreed.
Crowns rust. The {aa} endures.
The {aa} was patient. The {vp} was not.
Night falls early for the {va}.
What is taken cannot be untaken, ser {vp}.
The {aa} dines first tonight.
Cold ground makes equals of us all, {vp}.
Tell {vh} their {vp} died standing. It will be a kindness.
No ransom for a {vp}. The knight rides on.
The tower falls on whom it pleases.
Old stones outlast bold {vp}s.
The queen mourns no one twice.
A pawn dreams, and a {vp} dies.
The bishop keeps the faith. The {vp} kept nothing.
Kings bury their own, ser {vp}.
So falls the queen of {vh}. The songs will lie about this.

promotion_lines: Rise — the {h} banner climbs another rank.
From mud to glory — {h} makes it so.
